meta.title: Vendor modifies the counter offer — buyer QCS shows modified tag and new value
gaps: Vendor provides a remark explaining the counter-offer adjustment
Buyer QCS shows the vendor's specific remark because the remark content is not specified and no catalog assertion can identify the corresponding remark
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Vendor provides a remark explaining the counter-offer adjustment; Buyer QCS shows the vendor's specific remark because the remark content is not specified and no catalog assertion can identify the corresponding remark

steps.note: Open the prepared vendor session with the pending counter offer.
Open the prepared event's RFQ pricing round in the vendor portal.
Submit the vendor's revised counter-offer value of ₹85; this is the closest available vendor-side modification action.
Confirm the vendor's revised submission was accepted.
Return to the buyer's console to inspect the QCS.
Open the buyer's prepared Master QCS on the RFQ event.
Assert that the buyer QCS shows the modified price ₹85.
Assert that the QCS displays the required modified-counter-offer tag.
